summary: Iteration 1 cold codegen: 19 files under chemical_detector/ (two mode-nested controllers, sensors, Vehicle, command channel). All 81 requirements traced. 11 review items: design choices and invented defaults, none blocking.

issues.title: Gas analysis has no Final state; source-found goes to a live CONCLUDED sink
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 names a Final target. GasAnalysisController is the first-discovered machine (it receives the Isabelle theory), and a Final state there leaves deadlock_free unprovable. GAS_DETECTED --[ins >= thr]/ stop--> CONCLUDED; CONCLUDED self-loops on gas, retaining the reading (CD-GA-Var1) without analysing it or sending further commands.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm CONCLUDED is an acceptable realisation of 'concludes its search, processing no further readings'.

issues.title: Movement Found has an obstacle-triggered self-loop instead of a Final successor
issues.raw: CD-MV-Beh9 (Found_to_Final). FOUND keeps the robot halted; it only records obstacle sides (CD-MV-Var4) so the state stays live. flag and the halt move are transition actions on the stop transitions, so the self-loop does not emit flag again.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm an obstacle self-loop is acceptable in FOUND.

issues.title: Odometer modelled as a sensor read, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed 'event'. d0/d1 are sampled with odometer.distanceTravelled() inside the Avoiding entry and TryingAgain->AvoidingAgain actions, because the Java pattern cannot receive an input event inside an entry action.
issues.fix_directive: None unless an explicit odometer channel is required.

issues.title: Waiting 'during randomWalk()' is a top-of-mode statement
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1. Java calls vehicle.randomWalk() on every cycle spent in WAITING; the extractor renders top-of-mode statements as an entry action.

issues.title: Platform operations are Vehicle methods; changeDirection is its own class without compute()
issues.raw: CD-OP1..4 are actuations, not computations, so the compute()-only Operation shape does not fit. move is a two-argument call (an operation call in the model); changeDirection(l) has one argument and is therefore extracted as an output event carrying l.
issues.fix_directive: None unless changeDirection must appear as an operation call.

issues.title: Threshold guard written as ins >= THR rather than goreq(ins, thr)
issues.raw: CD-Fn4 / CD-GA-Beh6,7. On double intensities, >= is goreq. Writing it this way keeps the actual comparison in the extracted guard. goreq itself is used inside intensity() and location().

issues.title: Constant values
issues.raw: thr=3.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=1, stuckPeriod=2, stuckDist=1.0, outPeriod=1. The spec says 'configured at startup' but gives no values. They are kept small so model checking stays tractable.
issues.fix_directive: Replace with deployment values if known.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0.0, gs=[] (the spec gives only gs, as empty).

issues.title: What 'indicates the target chemical' means; intensity ignores chemical identity
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define 'indicates'. It is implemented as: some sensor has c == targetChemical (a constructor parameter) and i > 0. CD-Fn2 takes the maximum over ALL sensors whatever their chemical, and is implemented literally.
issues.fix_directive: Clarify whether intensity/location should be restricted to the target chemical.

issues.title: Mapping from sensor position to Angle
issues.raw: CD-Fn3 / CD-DM7 say the position maps to a direction but not which. Positions 1..4 map to Left, Right, Back, Front and repeat cyclically. An empty reading yields Front.
issues.fix_directive: Supply the physical sensor layout if different.

issues.title: Chem as a nat id, Intensity as real
issues.raw: CD-DM4/5 describe opaque/ordered types. Chem is an int species id (@nat), compared only by equality. Intensity is a double (@real).

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
